tools.name: maxcrm_get_account
tools.description: Show the Max CRM account behind the key: token access (full or read only), today's usage, limits and lead routing. Max CRM API: GET /api/v1/me.

tools.name: maxcrm_get_reference
tools.description: List the allowed lead statuses, lead types, origins, webhook events and limits. Use it before setting a status or lead type. Max CRM API: GET /api/v1/reference.

tools.name: maxcrm_list_leads
tools.description: List leads, newest first. Filter by status, source, phone or updated_since. Page with next_cursor. Max CRM API: GET /api/v1/leads.

tools.name: maxcrm_get_lead
tools.description: Show one lead by id, including monthly_premium, coverage_amount, policy_number and vendor when set. Max CRM API: GET /api/v1/leads/{id}.

tools.name: maxcrm_list_lead_notes
tools.description: List the notes on a lead's phone that this account wrote, newest first (up to 50). Max CRM API: GET /api/v1/leads/{id}/notes.

tools.name: maxcrm_list_appointments
tools.description: List appointments, newest first. Filter by first and last date (YYYY-MM-DD) or by lead. Page with next_cursor. Max CRM API: GET /api/v1/appointments.

tools.name: maxcrm_list_activity
tools.description: Read the newest-first feed of status changes, notes, calls and texts for this account's leads. Page with next_cursor. Max CRM API: GET /api/v1/activity.

tools.name: maxcrm_create_lead
tools.description: Add one lead to the account. Give a phone and a first or last name. A phone already on file returns DUPLICATE_PHONE with the existing lead id. The account's own new-lead rules (drip, first messages, consent) apply. Max CRM API: POST /api/v1/leads.

tools.name: maxcrm_update_lead
tools.description: Change some fields of one lead. Changing status goes through the same rules as the CRM and can start its automations. Fields not given stay as they are. Max CRM API: PATCH /api/v1/leads/{id}.

tools.name: maxcrm_add_lead_note
tools.description: Add one activity note to a lead's phone. The CRM keeps 25 notes per phone (NOTE_LIMIT_REACHED after that). Max CRM API: POST /api/v1/leads/{id}/notes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: maxcrm_list_activity · Private data: maxcrm_get_account, maxcrm_create_lead · Public sink: maxcrm_get_reference, maxcrm_create_lead, maxcrm_add_lead_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: maxcrm_list_activity · Private data: maxcrm_get_account, maxcrm_create_lead · Public sink: maxcrm_get_reference, maxcrm_create_lead, maxcrm_add_lead_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
